To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the environmental performance can be improved if the product carbon footprint of the second supply option is higher than the first one and the expected profit is not too low.

the product carbon foot print has a negative influence on economic performance and that the fast scenario has a positive influence on both economic and environmental performance compared to the onshore scenario.
the product carbon emissions can be reduced by dual sourcing and that the expected emissions can be further lowered by choosing a supplier who is located closer to the customer.

an important aspect of the purchasing and supply management process.
a single period inventory model for a product with a given carbon footprint benchmark and two supply options.
the environmental and the economic performance of a company.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
dual sourcing can improve the environmental performance.
the dual sourcing framework with a second fast supply option is the best strategy to minimize emissions and maximize profit.
the fast scenario is better than the onshore scenario.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the dual sourcing strategy is a powerful tool to improve economic performance and reduce environmental impact.
a product carbon footprint constraint can have a significant negative influence on the economic performance if the constraint is binding.
the environmental constraint has a negative impact for both sourcing scenarios.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the environmental performance can be improved at the expense of the economic performance.
dual sourcing is a powerful tool for environmental management and for the improvement of the economic performance.

the environmental constraint has a negative impact both on the expected profit and expected carbon footprint, i.e. a company with a high environmental target is forced to sacrifice economic performance in order to achieve the target.
